scope: Proposition 5.5 (Finite projection diagrams) of the manuscript “Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level” (preprints/Global-quantum-geometric-Langlands-at-irrational-level-October-4-2026/quantum-langlands.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 069 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d9bc135865dbc97), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a canonical finite triangle c MI,m −→ b F −→ b F⊥ such that c MI,m is a finite extension of images of the b Tσ and every b Hσ kills b F⊥. After field specialization, Fourier transform, and !-restriction at t = 1, its first map is the counit of Whittaker projection of π!FW . Denote that projection by MI,m. The augmented stages π! c MI,m −→ FW ⊠ δu=0 (5.6) form a geometric diagram under increases of pole bounds and closed diagonals of marked parameters. This entire diagram is linear in the single initial Kummer input.
